Question Choices: Fill: Write the coordinates of the point 2 units right of the origin and 7 units up. (__, __)
Hints: Right/up are positive; left/down are negative.
Solution: Horizontal motion gives x=2; vertical motion gives y=7. Write x first: (2,7).

Question Choices: Select. In which quadrant is the point $(-4, 9)$? ~~I | II | III | IV~~
Hints: Use both signs to choose one of the four quadrants.
Solution: The signs are x negative and y positive, placing the point in quadrant II. Quadrants I, II, III, IV have signs (+,+), (−,+), (−,−), (+,−), respectively.

Question Choices: Fill: Write the coordinates of the point 3 units left of the origin and 8 units down. (__, __)
Hints: Right/up are positive; left/down are negative.
Solution: Horizontal motion gives x=-3; vertical motion gives y=-8. Write x first: (-3,-8).

Question Choices: Select. Where is the point $(5, 0)$? ~~on-the-x-axis | on-the-y-axis | in-Quadrant-I | in-Quadrant-IV~~
Solution: At (5,0), y=0, so there is no vertical displacement and the point lies on the x-axis. An axis point belongs to no quadrant.

Question Choices: Fill: Reflect the point $(7, -2)$ over the x-axis. Write the new coordinates. (__, __)
Hints: Keep the coordinate along the mirror axis; negate the other.
Solution: Reflecting across the x-axis keeps x and reverses y. Thus (7,-2) becomes (7,2); the perpendicular distance to the mirror axis is unchanged.
